subject: Conformance for object orientation
notes: Rule text (cite.py --check 9.3.8.2.3 OK: '7) If either of the corresponding formal parameters or returning items in interface-1 or interface-2 is a strongly-typed group item, both are of the same type.'). Code: DescriptionMismatch calls StrongTypeMismatch FIRST for every formal and for a non-object RETURNING; 'same type' is StrongTypeModel.SameType, i.e. §8.5.3.1 equivalence (cite.py --check 8.5.3.1 OK: 'Two type declarations are considered equivalent when they have the same type-name, both have the same presence or absence of the EXTERNAL clause and the STRONG phrase, and for each elementary item ...'). DETERMINATION (kb/Work PB1012, w1091f): no implementor latitude and no owner decision — an interface prototype CAN carry a strong type, because §10.6.2 SR4 e) (cite OK: 'The data division may contain only a linkage section') leaves it a linkage section and a TYPEDEF entry is legal there; and 'the same type' across two source elements is §8.5.3.1 equivalence (same type-name, same STRONG/EXTERNAL presence, same elementary layout and clauses), which is what SameType implements. The WORKING-STORAGE route in a prototype is refused by §10.6.2 SR4 e) (COBOL2272), correctly. Witnesses over every asker of the one rule set: object IMPLEMENTS (§11.8.3 SR2) — positive l1c05_oo_strong_type_same_type; negatives l1c05-oo-strong-type-other-name (TT vs TU, identical layout), -vs-plain-group (strong vs plain group), -returning-other (the RETURNING half) (golden-lane-1 wave 1, 3031e2e90); override (§11.7.3 SR9) and FACTORY IMPLEMENTS (§11.4.3 SR2) — positive pb1012_strong_type_override_factory, negatives pb1012-strong-type-override-layout-differs (same type-name, PIC X(4) vs X(5): COBOL0829) and pb1012-strong-type-factory-strong-one-side (STRONG on the prototype only: COBOL0841). The interface INHERITS asker (§11.6.3 SR5) was re-probed on the w1091f build: two inherited SWAPT prototypes typed TT and TU are refused (COBOL2762), equivalent TT declarations accepted. || Editions (adjudicator, verbatim): 2002, 2014, 2023 (strongly-typed groups: TYPEDEF STRONG, 2002+) retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Oo/OoConformance.cs#DescriptionMismatch (kb/Work PB3101 (wave 1082): the DataItem comparator family is deleted (OoConformance.DescriptionMismatch, StrongTypeMismatch, AsIfElementaryGroupMismatch, IsCategoryAlphanumeric, PictureClauseIdentity.Mismatch, ObjectRefDescriptor.SameDescriptionAs); every activation and pair-mode question describes its items through ActivationDescriptions and asks ActivationRelations (CallArgumentViolation / CallReturningViolation / MatchViolation / SignatureDifference), the PICTURE identity entering through PictureClauseIdentity.Key) retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Oo/OoConformance.cs#StrongTypeMismatch (kb/Work PB3101 (wave 1082): the DataItem comparator family is deleted (OoConformance.DescriptionMismatch, StrongTypeMismatch, AsIfElementaryGroupMismatch, IsCategoryAlphanumeric, PictureClauseIdentity.Mismatch, ObjectRefDescriptor.SameDescriptionAs); every activation and pair-mode question describes its items through ActivationDescriptions and asks ActivationRelations (CallArgumentViolation / CallReturningViolation / MatchViolation / SignatureDifference), the PICTURE identity entering through PictureClauseIdentity.Key)
